[[203.5]] 62. GEORGE CHEYNE AN LEIBNIZ

[[203.6]] 20. (31.) März 1704

[[204.3]] Sir

[[204.4]] I did Receive a very large pacquett from M^#'r Bernoulli at Groninghen about 6 weeks ago,

[[204.5]] but a long time after the date of his letters, for they came from thence by a privat hand, who was

[[204.6]] hindred in his passage, If you have any correspondence with him (as I imagin you may have)

[[204.7]] pray Give my most hearty service to him and acquaint him that the reason why I have delay'd

[[204.8]] to answer his Last; was waiting till I shou'd have an opportunity of sending him M^#'r Newton and

[[204.9]] [de] Moivre's books, Besides his letters require my time and Consideration, I have not had four

[[204.10]] hours peacable leisure since I receiv'd 'em, the Necessities of Life and my Employment having

[[204.11]] taken up all my hours. But I shall delay no longer writing to him. Pray you Sir be so kind as to

[[204.12]] tell him this how soon you write to him I am

[[204.13]] Sir Your most humble Servant Geo. Cheyne

[[204.14]] March 20^#'t^#'h 1703/4
